https://terrytao.wordpress.com/2026/11/0.summary: In a guest post, Frank Calegari says mathematicians should not be sad about OpenAI’s release of more than 700 AI-written research papers. He compares the moment to the classification of finite simple groups: the field must check and rewrite the results, reward people who return to old problems, and use the new tools to ask deeper questions.

https://www.jefftk.com/p/bidirectional-c.title: Bidirectional Charging During Grid Outages
https://www.jefftk.com/p/bidirectional-c.summary:
The author wants an electric car that powers the house in a blackout and also recharges from solar panels, but finds almost no product that does both today.

- GM’s V2H bundle powers the home during an outage, but does not say the car can recharge while the grid is down.
- Ford’s Charge Station Pro, which automatic home backup needs, is no longer for sale.
- Wallbox’s Quasar 2 for Kia has reported problems, and cannot use solar charging and V2H at the same time.
- Tesla Powershare with a Cybertruck is the only setup found that recharges from solar during an outage.
- Enphase targets volume production of a bidirectional charger in Q4 2026, but the author expects a delay.
- For now, the author plans a smaller battery only for emergencies.
